full_state_ancestry: Recorded native before-update exact-state validation; not repeated in this review.

conventions.costs: Both policies scored with the saved parent objective (yaw weight .8); child costs are offline state rescoring, not a new rollout. No summed-return ranking.
conventions.frames: Full wxyz quaternion body-to-world rotation; cross-track fixed to command-onset heading. Body angular-z differs from Euler heading derivative under tilt.
conventions.windows: First commanded second, complete 30 s movement, last 10 s movement; complete 8 s stop and final 2 s. Stand 30 s, startup 0-5 s, late 20-30 s.
conventions.backtracking: All opposing signed pose increments, no filtering; maximum backtrack from a prior extreme. Translation projected along the preceding moving command; yaw projected by command sign.
conventions.contacts: Policy-rate sampled self/non-wheel contacts; 200 Hz ground/clearance/control-force only for forward and positive lateral. Absence is not a continuous contact guarantee.

analysis_validation: New signed-progress backtracking passes known forward/reverse paths.
Reuse established quaternion/sensor/swing analysis; each 200 Hz trace checks base-pose agreement with 50 Hz endpoints.

intermediate_metadata.reason: Final forward/holding regressions and unchanged lateral path error; one intermediate, four relevant cases only; no new 200 Hz capture needed.

forward.cross_track_definition: Line through moving-segment start pose along its initial heading; heading from unwrapped pose projection, not integrated body angular-z
forward.speed: Report achieved body vx, bias and RMSE alongside trajectory; slowing/stopping to meet the path targets is unacceptable. Use .45-.55 m/s mean and <=.04 m/s RMSE as a declared development comparison band.

stand.rotation: Also report late body angular-z RMS/bias and full 30 s pose-derived heading change. Both must improve over CK499 (.00670 rad/s RMS, -11.1 deg); translation alone cannot qualify holding. Retain comparison to CK250 (.00030 rad/s late RMS).
stand.startup: Report 0-5 s displacement/path separately from late hold

frozen_requirements.stopping: No material increase in full 8 s stop path, backward excursion/reversal, or final residual motion versus CK499. Report endpoint and path separately, early braking and final 2 s XY/yaw; compare CK250 and original V3 too. CK499 fast stop endpoint/path .0311/.1051 m, final XY RMS .00544 m/s.
frozen_requirements.stepping: Retain both lateral and yaw signs, partial +/- .03 commands, physical cycles/clearance distribution and loaded motion; no material regression in tracking/cross-axis drift or transitions. Existing partial lateral cross-axis drift remains unqualified.
frozen_requirements.placement: Move actual front/rear widths and pair midpoints toward the saved corridor while retaining support, height, tracking, stops and necessary corrective actions; no falls/non-wheel contacts or worsening saturation hidden by averages.
frozen_requirements.material_change: Use the previous approximately 15% comparison bands descriptively for stop path/reversal and retained-step metrics; inspect absolute magnitudes, censored cycles and signs. This is not a universal pass/fail or safety certification. Do not silently relax the stated path/heading/stand targets after results.

decision.classification: Keep CK1999 as the unqualified development baseline; do not promote CK2498 or CK2250.
decision.rationale: Final improves pure-yaw RMSE, direct lateral body-x bias and front clearance, but forward path, lateral stopping and holding translation regress. The intermediate is not a better overall candidate.
decision.next_action: Close this continuation and retain the parent; no further training or configuration change.
decision.qualification: Parent also misses frozen forward path/heading and holding-rotation targets. This is checkpoint selection, not navigation or hardware qualification.

unavailable: Termination counts/causes and event-level failure associations
Realized command-tier time shares in this diagnostics stream
Separate broad/precision training channels; replay states can be rescored
training.interpretation: Post-startup windows. Reward rates pooled over rollout ticks; normalized yaw is kernel score, not accuracy or an invertible RMSE. TensorBoard episode rates are reported separately. No total-return ranking.
training.push_scope: Mean of retained per-update event summaries, not pooled counts or failure attribution.

limits: One deterministic nominal seed/reset; reverse, small/mixed/core-edge commands, reserve extremes, pushes, DR, Sim2Sim and hardware remain unqualified.
Intermediate2250 tested only on stand, forward and both lateral signs; its pure-yaw cases were not tested.

No action deadband, heading correction or stand controller. Any future stand mode requires braking/correction, stop/start, small-command and disturbance validation; zero wheel-velocity target is not zero torque or a rigid lock.
Floor occupancy is recorded post-update std occupancy, not action saturation. Contact samples cannot establish continuous absence. Hysteresis event counts depend on sample rate.
Sensor measurements describe rigid-body motion, not image quality or jerk. Cost magnitude is not a policy gradient.
